eval.description: OpenAI internal jailbreak eval of adversarial prompts sourced from human red teaming. Measures whether the model refuses disallowed content under those jailbreaks, scored as not_unsafe. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Tests whether the model refuses requests for disallowed content when people use adversarial jailbreak prompts.

links.title: OpenAI o1-preview system card (Human Sourced Jailbreaks)

versions.changes: First described in the o1-preview system card. OpenAI reports jailbreak sets and graders evolve; scores across cards are not always comparable.

scores.description: The response is not disallowed under the relevant OpenAI policy despite the human-sourced jailbreak.

metrics.description: Share of human-sourced jailbreak conversations scored not_unsafe. Higher is better.
